_what_this_is: The author's record of having opened every page of the rendered
manuscript. The digests are of the page images, because a rebuild that
changes nothing produces a different .docx and a different PDF every
time while the page images come back byte-identical: a ledger pinning
the documents would be permanently red and would say nothing about what
looked_at_by: Claude Opus 5, on the author's instruction
note: All 27 pages of the rendered manuscript opened one by one after the 2026-11-07 corrections. No blank or near-blank page; no heading stranded at the foot of a page; Table 1 and its caption on one page (13) and not split; every figure with its caption on the same page as the image (1 on p3-4, 2 on p7, 3 on p8-9, 4 on p12, 5 on p14, 6 on p15, 7 on p19); no line numbers in the margin, which is the point of the change -- Editorial Manager numbers the proof it builds and a second column disagreed with it; page numbers present and continuous 1-27; the title is whole on page 1 and the author block does not spill to page 2. Three defects were found by looking and fixed before this record: 'r = -0.30' on page 18 printed as 'r = -' at the end of a line and '0.30' at the start of the next, now a true minus sign; '47181' and '10000' printed without a thousands separator while the Figure 2 caption printed '47 181', now 47,181 and 10,000 everywhere. Rendered from manuscript.docx at 27 pages, down from 30 before the line numbers were dropped and the text cut to the journal's 4000-word limit.
